title: Searching for New Physics with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.10382v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Finding new physics (NP) is the fundamental problem in particle physics today. Studying anomalies, i.e., measurements of low-energy observables whose values disagree with the predictions of the Standard Model (SM), is a powerful search strategy. The SM Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) provides a general model-independent framework for parametrizing NP; given some anomalies, it is natural to try to find the SMEFT operator(s) that can explain them. This is a challenging task because (i) the number of SMEFT operators is enormous, and (ii) at loop level there are very complicated correlations among the operators. Analyses by humans typically rely on phenomenological intuition to decide which operators are relevant. This is often biased and does not explore the complete SMEFT operator space. translated_title: 用强化学习寻找新物理
translated_abstract: 寻找新物理（NP）是当今粒子物理学的根本问题。研究反常现象（即测量值与标准模型（SM）预测不符的低能观测量）是一种强有力的搜索策略。标准模型有效场论（SMEFT）为参数化新物理提供了一个通用的、不依赖于具体模型的框架；面对某些反常现象，自然的做法是寻找能够解释它们的SMEFT算符。然而这是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为：（一）SMEFT算符的数量极其庞大；（二）在圈图层面，算符之间存在非常复杂的关联。人工分析通常依赖唯象直觉来判断哪些算符是相关的，这种方法往往带有偏见，且无法遍历完整的SMEFT算符空间。有趣的是，强化学习（RL）技术恰恰擅长于需要通过决策制定来实现目标的任务。在本文中，我们介……
tldr: 本文提出利用强化学习技术，在庞大且高度关联的SMEFT算符空间中自动搜索能够解释实验反常的新物理算符，克服了人工分析依赖直觉、带有偏见且覆盖不全的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using reinforcement learning to automatically search the vast and highly correlated SMEFT operator space for new physics operators that can explain experimental anomalies, overcoming the bias and incompleteness of intuition-based human analyses.
